description: This file defines macros, classes, and functions for tracing and performance event logging, including support for counters, asynchronous events, and scope-based event management, used for application performance monitoring.

classes.name: gl::TraceEvent::TraceID
classes.description: Encapsulates an ID for trace events, which can be an integer or pointer, with pointer IDs being mangled with process ID.

classes.name: gl::TraceEvent::TraceStringWithCopy
classes.description: A simple wrapper for const char* to indicate the string should be copied when used in trace events.

classes.name: gl::TraceEvent::TraceEndOnScopeClose
classes.description: Manages automatic insertion of end trace event when scope ends, for scope-based event timing.

methods.name: addTraceEvent
methods.description: Adds a trace event with specified parameters, supporting different argument types and counts.
